english.note: Use this for a person who is composed and not anxious or angry; it is the all-purpose choice for emotional calm.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 laang5 zing6 di1 sin1 laa1

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on staying calm and thinking clearly instead of being carried away by emotion.

exampleSentences.english: Faced with so many problems, they remained sedate and thought things through one by one.
exampleSentences.traditional: 面對咁多問題，佢仲可以保持冷靜，逐樣諗清楚。
exampleSentences.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 man6 tai4 keoi5 zung6 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6 zuk6 joeng2 nam2 cing1 co2

english.note: Use this when the focus is on keeping control and not becoming emotionally agitated, especially in a tense situation.

exampleSentences.english: Even if the other person yells at you, you need to stay tranquil.
exampleSentences.traditional: 就算對方鬧你，你都要保持冷靜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zau6 syun3 deoi3 fong1 naau6 nei5 nei5 dou1 jiu3 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6

english.note: Use 冷靜 for someone who remains calm and level-headed under pressure.

exampleSentences.english: Even when people are yelling at you, you still need to stay level.
exampleSentences.traditional: 就算俾人鬧，你都要冷靜啲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zau6 syun3 bei2 jan4 naau6 nei5 dou1 jiu3 laang5 zing6 di1

english.note: Use 冷靜 when someone remains calm and is not easily upset or excited.

exampleSentences.english: You stayed steady even after something so serious happened; that's really impressive.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你遇到咁大件事都仲咁冷靜，真係難得。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 jyu6 dou2 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6 dou1 zung6 gam3 laang5 zing6 zan1 hai6 naan4 dak1

english.note: Use 冷靜 when telling someone to stay calm and keep control of their emotions.

exampleSentences.english: Stay cool and tell me slowly.
exampleSentences.jyutping: laang5 zing6 di1 maan6 maan6 gong2
